## Import library

```{r}
library(here)
```

## Downloads

```{r}
# extract nhanes
source(here("R", "download_nhanes.R"))
fetch <- read.csv(here("config", "sources.csv"), sep = ";")
components <- setdiff(names(fetch), c("cycle", "start_year")) 

for (row in 1:nrow(fetch)) {
  for (comp in components) {
    tryCatch(
      download_nhanes_file(
        start_year = fetch$start_year[row], 
        file = fetch[[comp]][row], 
        dest_dir = here("data", "raw"), 
        type = "nhanes"),
      error = function(e) message("FAILED: ", fetch$cycle[row], " ", comp, " - ", conditionMessage(e))
    )
  }
}

# extract nchs
mortality = paste0("NHANES_", gsub("-", "_", fetch$cycle), "_MORT_2019_PUBLIC.dat")
for(mort_file in mortality){
  tryCatch(
    download_nhanes_file(
      file = mort_file, 
      dest_dir = here("data", "raw"), 
      type = "nchs"),
    error = function(e) message("FAILED: ", mort_file, " - ", conditionMessage(e))
  )
}

```
